requirements_summary.summary: Participium is a web application for the Municipality of Turin enabling citizens to report urban issues (e.g., potholes, trash) via an interactive map or Telegram bot. Reports undergo a lifecycle: Pending Approval -> Assigned (to technical offices) -> In Progress -> Resolved/Rejected/Suspended. The system supports external maintainers (with or without platform access), internal communication channels, notifications (email/push), and detailed statistics for administrators.

requirements.text:
As an external maintainer 
I want to update the status of a report assigned to me
So that I can updated citizens about  the intervention.
expected_behaviors: I can updated citizens about  the intervention

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member/external maintainer
I want to exchange information and comments on the report internally
So that coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens
expected_behaviors: coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens

requirements.text:
As a citizen
I want to register with my name and username 
So that I can access the Participium system and submit reports.
constraints: Registration is required before submitting reports.
expected_behaviors: I can access the Participium system and submit reports

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to confirm my registration with a code
So that my account becomes valid and I can start using the system.
constraints: Once a registration is completed, the user gets an email with a confirmation code. The person can use the application only after confirming by entering the code valid for 30 minutes.
expected_behaviors: my account becomes valid and I can start using the system

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to set up municipality users
constraints: These are the internal accounts of the municipality

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to assign roles to municipality users
constraints: Possible roles: municipal public relations officer, municipal administrator, technical office staff member, external maintainer. You can be more specific on technical offices to run realisti scenarios following the official organizational structure of the municipality of Turin (https://trasparenza.comune.torino.it/media/2212/download)

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to provide details for my report 
So that the the problem is classified correctly.
constraints: Mandatory fields: title, description,  category , photos (min 1 max 3).
expected_behaviors: the the problem is classified correctly

requirements.text:
As a municipal public relations officer
I want to review and approve or reject reports 
So that only valid reports are processed further.
constraints: Rejected reports must include an explanation. If accepted, the report is assigned to the technical office bound to the report category.
expected_behaviors: only valid reports are processed further

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to choose whether to make my report anonymous 
So that my name is not shown in the public list of reports.
constraints: Anonymous option protects privacy. Choice made at issue description time.
expected_behaviors: my name is not shown in the public list of reports

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to see the list of reports assigned to me
So that I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done
expected_behaviors: I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to configure my account
So that I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence.
constraints: Citizens can  upload a personal photo, add their Telegram username and switch off/on email notifications in the configuration panel.
expected_behaviors: I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence

requirements.text:
As a citizen/unregistered user 
I want to search for reports in a specific area by typing in an address
So that I can easily explore and analyze existing reports in that specific area.
constraints: You can choose how much to zoom in. The product owner will then provide feedback on the implementation.
expected_behaviors: I can easily explore and analyze existing reports in that specific area

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to modify roles to municipality users
So that the staff can be more flexible.
constraints: This story overwrites a previous answer given by PO on the Telegram chat. NB: 1) A municipality user can now have multiple roles, i.e. serving on more than one technical office. 2) Modification includes cancellation.
expected_behaviors: the staff can be more flexible

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member 
I want to update report statuses 
So that citizens are informed of the problem resolution process.
constraints: At each status change, the citizen receives notification in the platform with the corresponding update. Municipal operators working on reports can also send messages to the citizens in the platform, to which the citizen can reply.
expected_behaviors: citizens are informed of the problem resolution process

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to reply to messages from municipal operators in the platform 
So that I can communicate directly about my report.
constraints: Two-way communication is possible within the platform.
expected_behaviors: I can communicate directly about my report

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to receive optional email alerts in addition to platform notifications 
So that I can choose the best way to stay updated.
constraints: Unless disabled in their configuration panel.
expected_behaviors: I can choose the best way to stay updated

requirements.text:
As a citizen /unregistered user
I want to see public statistics about reports 
So that I understand trends in city issues.
constraints: Public statistics  (visible on the site) include the number of reports by category and trends by day, week, or month.
expected_behaviors: I understand trends in city issues

requirements.text:
As a municipal administrator 
I want to see detailed private statistics 
So that I can monitor usage and performance of the system.
constraints:
Private statistics (for administrators only), in addition to public ones, also include charts and tables about:  
  - number of reports by status  
  - number of reports by type  
  - number of reports by type and status  
  - number of reports by reporter  
  - number of reports by reporter and type  
  - number of reports by reporter, type and status  
  - number of reports by the top 1% of reporters, by type  
  - number of reports by the top 5% of reporters, by type
expected_behaviors: I can monitor usage and performance of the system

requirements.text:
As a citizen/unregistered user
I want to browse a summary table of reports with filters 
So that I can easily explore and analyze existing reports.
constraints: Filters: by category, status, period of time
expected_behaviors: I can easily explore and analyze existing reports

domain_rules: Reports must be in 'Pending Approval' state until the Organization Office performs preliminary verification.
Accepted reports move to 'Assigned' state and are sent to the competent technical office depending on the problem category.
Rejected reports require a mandatory explanation from the Municipality Organization Office.
Once submitted, a report cannot be modified or deleted by the citizen.
Anonymous user's name is visible to staff but hidden in the public map view for citizens.
Only technical office staff members can have multiple roles.
External maintainers are added by the system administrator and must have individual accounts.
Communication between technical office and external maintainer (Case 1) is report-specific and reserved (not visible to reporter).
Automatic assignment of all issues of a certain category is possible only if previously set by the municipal administrator.
Notifications/messages can be set to either real-time or on page refresh depending on user preference.
Public statistics are visible to unregistered users; private statistics are for administrators only.
edge_cases: External company has no access to Participium (Case 2): External company updates technical office out of system, and technical office staff moves report to 'Resolved'.
Zooming out on the map groups reports into a cumulative view showing total number.
Downloading the summary table with active filters only exports the filtered subset.
Telegram bot commands (/help, /contact, /faq) provide assistance without requiring login for basic info, but report creation/checking requires user context.
assumptions: The 'Organization Office' refers to a specific administrative body within the Municipality of Turin responsible for initial review.
Competent technical office is determined by the problem category (e.g., Public Lighting -> Enel X or specific office).
Telegram bot integration requires the user to have provided a valid Telegram username in their configuration panel.
Email notifications are sent unless explicitly disabled in the user's configuration panel.

authentication_notes: /auth/login and /auth/register are the only public entry points for authentication.
/auth/verify-email must be called after /auth/register before other authenticated endpoints work.
All non-auth endpoints except /categories, /offices, /reports/public, /reports/nearby, and /reports/{id} require authentication.
Admin operations (/users/municipality*, /roles) require elevated privileges implied by auth_required=true.
Operations marked auth_required need an authenticated session during test setup.

risks: POST /auth/register does not document email verification flow explicitly; client may assume immediate access.
/reports/{id} GET is public but PATCH is authenticated; potential race condition if public read allows unauthenticated updates (mitigated by auth check).
No documented rate limiting or brute-force protection for /auth/login and /auth/register.
POST /profiles/telegram/link does not specify token handling or expiration risks.
DELETE /users/municipality/user/{id} lacks soft-delete or audit trail documentation.
GET /reports/user/{userId} exposes user-specific data; ensure userId is validated against authenticated session context to prevent IDOR.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen registers with name and username to access the system.
strategy_items.prompt: Register a new citizen user account with a valid name, unique username, and email. Verify successful registration response and session creation if applicable.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the primary entry point for citizen access to the Participium system.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen registration fails due to duplicate username.
strategy_items.prompt: Attempt to register a citizen using an existing username. Verify the system rejects the request with an appropriate error code indicating the username is taken.
setup_needed: Execute a successful registration for user 'existing_user' to populate the database.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete the test user 'existing_user' created in setup.
strategy_items.rationale: Ensures data integrity and prevents duplicate accounts, a critical security and usability requirement.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: External maintainer updates the status of a report assigned to them.
strategy_items.prompt: Authenticate as an external maintainer. Fetch a report currently in 'Assigned' state where this user is the assignee. Update the report status to 'In Progress'. Verify the update succeeds and the new status is reflected.
setup_needed: Create a test report via POST /reports with categoryId from GET /categories (satisfying dependency_edges). Assign the report to the authenticated external maintainer.
Ensure the report is in 'Assigned' state.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete the created report using DELETE /reports/{id} if the API supports it, or verify no resource was created by checking the list of reports for this user.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core workflow for external maintainers to manage assigned tasks.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Technical office staff exchanges information and comments on a report internally.
strategy_items.prompt: Authenticate as a technical office staff member. POST a new comment to an existing report. Verify the comment is created successfully and is visible in GET /reports/{id}/comments.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member/external maintainer.
Create a test report via POST /reports with categoryId from GET /categories (satisfying dependency_edges).
Ensure the report is in 'Assigned' state.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete the created comment if the API supports individual deletion, or verify no resource was created by checking the comments list.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates internal coordination capabilities without exposing data to unauthorized parties.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen replies to messages from municipal operators in the platform.
strategy_items.prompt: Authenticate as a citizen. POST a reply message to an existing report where a municipal operator has previously sent a message. Verify the reply is created and visible in GET /reports/{id}/messages.
setup_needed: Authenticate as citizen.
Create a test report via POST /reports with categoryId from GET /categories (satisfying dependency_edges).
Simulate a municipal operator sending a message to the report (via POST /reports/{id}/messages) to establish context.
Ensure the report is in 'Assigned' state.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete the created reply message if the API supports individual deletion, or verify no resource was created by checking the messages list.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the two-way communication channel between citizens and operators.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: System administrator sets up a new municipality user.
strategy_items.prompt: Create a new municipality user with valid attributes (username, password, email). Assert 201 Created and verify the user appears in subsequent GET /users/municipality lists. Use an admin role for authentication.
setup_needed: Ensure a valid admin session exists (login if necessary).
Retrieve list of available roles via GET /roles to include in the payload.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: DELETE /users/municipality/user/{id} where {id} is the ID returned from this test.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core user provisioning capability for PT02.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: System administrator assigns roles to an existing municipality user.
strategy_items.prompt: Assign a specific role (e.g., 'viewer') to a specific office for the target municipality user. Use the user ID and office ID obtained from previous setup steps. Assert 200 OK and verify the assignment in the response.
setup_needed: Authenticate as system administrator.
POST /users/municipality to create a test user.
GET /offices to obtain an office ID.
GET /roles to obtain a role ID.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: DELETE /users/municipality/user/{id}/office-roles/{officeId} using the specific officeId and roleId assigned in this test.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the role assignment workflow for PT03.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen creates a report with the anonymous flag set to true.
strategy_items.prompt: Create a new report for an authenticated citizen user with 'anonymous': true in the payload. Assert 201 Created. Verify that the response indicates anonymity is active and the public view would hide the name (conceptually).
setup_needed: POST /auth/register to create a citizen account.
POST /auth/verify-email to activate the account.
GET /categories to obtain a valid categoryId.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the anonymous reporting feature defined in PT15.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: System administrator attempts to verify an email for a non-existent registration token.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute verification with a random UUID string that was never generated by the /auth/register endpoint. Assert 404 Not Found or 400 Bad Request.
setup_needed: Ensure a valid admin session exists (login if necessary).
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests robustness against random token injection attempts.
